policy: This is an input observation ledger, not a percentage of semantic compatibility. Omitted defaults may have been exercised; PHP fixtures without captured templates are not silently inferred. Page template declarations are not counted as semantic assertions. Expected guard failures are labeled by verification_kind and are not successful rendered-output or original-matching evidence; native HTTP templates are captured separately when available.
